Mistravora is a digital solutions company founded in May 2025 by Husni and co-founded by Shakeel, delivering mobile applications, custom software, websites and end-to-end digital solutions for businesses of all sizes and industries. With no restriction to a single market or sector, Mistravora focuses on building practical, scalable and modern digital solutions around each client's requirements.
